meta.description: Reading movers for short local hops: across town, a few streets over or between floors. 2-hour minimum with travel included. Get a free quote.

overview: Not every Reading move needs a long drive. Some go across town, some go a few streets over, and some never leave the property at all.
Short jobs like these are billed by the hour, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time keeps them in proportion.
sellingPoints: Moves across town or down the street

servicesBlock.intro: Local moves inside Reading are the usual work here, along with furniture-only jobs and storage. A short move still gets the full crew treatment: wrapped furniture, a strapped load and beds rebuilt at the other end. If your move turns out to be longer, the long distance service on the list below covers it.

whyChoose.h2: Why Reading Residents Call Us for Short Moves

cards.title: A Minimum That Fits
cards.text: A move a few streets over might take an hour of work. The minimum is two hours with travel included, so you know the floor of the bill before you book.

cards.title: Basement to Bedroom
cards.text: Need a treadmill out of the basement or a dresser up to the second floor? Moving heavy pieces between floors of the same house is a job we take.

cards.title: Short Trip, Same Wrapping
cards.text: A dresser going a quarter mile gets the same blankets and shrink wrap as one heading across the state.

cards.title: Storage for In-Between Weeks
cards.text: When the dates do not line up, your things can sit in storage for a few weeks and come back to the new address on the day you pick.

faq.q: Do you take moves that stay inside Reading?
faq.a: Yes. Moves within town are local moves billed by the hour. Send both addresses and the size of the home, and the manager prices it the same day you ask.

faq.q: How are short Reading moves billed when the addresses are close together?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, however short the gap between your two addresses. The minimum keeps a tiny job from costing less than the trip to reach you.

faq.q: Can you carry heavy items between floors of my Reading house?
faq.a: Yes. Shifting furniture or equipment between the basement, the main floor and upstairs is work we take on, and it falls under the 2-hour minimum.

faq.q: What does a two-hour minimum mean for a short Reading job?
faq.a: You pay for at least two hours, and the drive from our yard counts toward them. A one-hour job with a one-hour drive meets it.

faq.q: Does the truck need a parking spot for a Reading move?
faq.a: It helps a lot. Tell us where the truck can stop at both addresses, and the crew plans the carry from there.

faqClosing: Anything else on booking or payment is answered on the FAQ page.

closing.h2: Tell Us About Your Reading Move
closing.body: Even a short move needs a few details: what is moving, from where to where and the date. Send them over and a manager will price the job. If it is only a few pieces, list them, since that changes the crew size.
